structure.layout: single-column marketing landing page: sticky top nav, centered hero with product screenshot, logo wall, bento feature cards, use-case card row, testimonial cards, stats strip, full-width CTA band, multi-column footer

aesthetics.typography: NotionInter (custom Inter) for all UI, headlines and body; Lyon Text serif used only for testimonial and footer quotations
aesthetics.typeScale: Very high contrast: 96px bold tight-tracked hero H1, 54px section H2s, 42–48px CTA heading, 22px card titles, 16–18px body, 14px labels/eyebrows, 12px meta; heavy weight on headlines vs 400 body

notes: Notion's signature monochrome look: pure black on white with warm off-white surfaces (#f9f9f8/#f6f5f4) and a single saturated blue for CTAs. Hero headline embeds a pale-blue pill with a blue dot and the animated word 'Think'. Hand-drawn black ink sketch characters (Notion's illustrations) peek around the product screenshot. Testimonial cards use heavily tinted brand-colour photos (red, blue, amber) with serif quotes. Logo wall appears overlaid on hero screenshot in the capture (sticky positioning artefact). Cookie consent is a floating bottom-right panel (proposed banner placement value). Mega menu items are illustrated cards on pastel tints.
